findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Scale. Each unfinished story part merged before the seven weekly search windows triggers a separate `gh pr list --head` request. A project with 30 such parts makes at least 38 list calls on the first board run each minute, instead of the specified eight, making normal board reads slow. The added older-part test covers only one branch.
findings.title: Older merged parts cause unbounded GitHub requests

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. The HTML totals explicitly omit `finished_last_7_days`, although `team.counts` includes its part and fix counts and the guide says the page prints the same totals. A merged item from yesterday appears in the JSON seven-day count but has no corresponding count on the page.
findings.title: Not done: show finished-last-seven-days counts on the page

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Gate. The supplied proof list now says only `passed` twice beneath each claim. It names no runnable test selector or check result for the parametrized cases starting here, so the required proof cannot be matched to counts, shared readiness, caching, approval, or the older-part runway.
findings.title: Not done: proof list

stop.reason: Nobody answered in 30 minutes; the repo's default narrows the part to its Done-when lines and files each open finding as a follow-up fix
